name: Attio
tagline: Look up and keep your CRM: people, companies, deals, notes and tasks.
summary: Search, read and write the user's Attio workspace: people, companies, deals and other records, lists, notes, tasks, comments, and the emails and calls Attio keeps. Existing records are changed or merged only after the user approves.
can: Search your records, lists, notes, emails and call recordings
Add records, notes, tasks and comments, and put records on lists
Change or merge existing records, only after you approve it
